CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 66
   B. 17
   C. 22
   D. 34

2. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.6
   C. 23
   D. 23.7

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 2/2
   D. They are equal

4. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 21

5. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 21
   C. 42
   D. 90

7. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 19.6

8. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 8
   C. 32
   D. 9

9. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

10. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 1

11. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 1

12. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 37
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

13. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.7
   C. 27.6
   D. 27

14. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 3, 6, 9
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 1, 2, 3, 6

15. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

16. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
